title: נחום המדי

paragraphs: Naḥum the Mede, Mishnah Shabbat 2:1; Bava Batra 5:2, where he is simply Naḥum. He lived during the Second Temple and after its destruction. Nazir 5:4 (32b) has him release the nazirites who came from exile and found the Temple destroyed, asking whether they would have vowed had they known. Some say in the Gemara—Ketubbot 105a, R. Natan says—he was one of Jerusalem's three judges of decrees (see his entry). In Avodah Zarah 1 he stated several rulings, and they said, 'Let the matter sink away and not be said.' Nazir, Beit Shammai: 'In this Naḥum the Mede erred.' Maimonides writes that he is mentioned only in Shabbat 2, but he also occurs in Mishnah HaMokher Et HaSefinah 78a and Nazir above.
